profile.name: 惠普 85645A 射频信号发生器
profile.description: 这是一台台式射频信号发生器，可输出频率和幅度可调的电信号，并支持输出开关与输出耦合设置。它常用于电子与射频实验中的激励源、器件表征、测试校准以及系统响应测量。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop RF signal generator that provides electrical signals with adjustable frequency and amplitude, with configurable output enable and output coupling. It is commonly used as a stimulus source in electronics and RF labs for device characterization, test calibration, and response measurements.
